question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Gate-crasher

options.text: A person who enters an event without any invitation
A cobra that lives in gardens

solution:
The correct answer is: **A person who enters event without any invitation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given idiom **"Gate-crasher"** refers to a person who attends a social event without being invited or without paying. This individual typically enters parties, weddings, or other gatherings uninvited. (बिना बुलाए जो किसी इवेंट में चले आते हैं)

 
 
• **Example: **The event was going well until a gate-crasher disrupted the proceedings.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is- ***A person who enters an event without any invitation***.
